messages: Jules: Heads up — I'm seeing weird oscillations in ap-northeast1 spot availability around 03:00 UTC. interruption rate spikes then drops in ~3-4m cycles, SLO risk for real-time inferencing. ops-bot: (automated) alert: spot_interruption_rate(ap-northeast1-gpu) breached threshold x3 in 15m window :rotating_light: Jules: Screenshot of Grafana below, and a quick PromQL I ran: ```sum(rate(spot_interruption_events{region="ap-northeast1"}[5m])) / sum(max(capacity_available_gpus{region="ap-northeast1"},1))``` Priya: hmm could be noisy signals from mixed instance types — some NVIDA A10p vs A100 preemptions. Marco: also check network-related evictions — saw a transient routing flap last night. Chen: threw a synthetic probe into the pool to validate: ```for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS https://inference.api/redwood/ping -H 'X-Probe: apne1' || echo fail; sleep 6; done``` — probe shows ~6% fail bursts aligned with interruptions. Sofia: Can we smooth alerts so on-call isn't paged for the short blips? proposal: add refractory window 10m and require two consecutive 5m breach buckets before paging. Priya: Agree, plus add a composite SLO metric that weights median latency and capacity-availability, not just raw interruption rate. Marco: For mitigation — shift low-priority batches to on-demand during window and drain KV cache warmups. I can push a canary policy in the routing layer if we decide. Jules: Also think about adding a synthetic parity metric that compares spot_eviction_score vs cloud provider preemption_signal; will help correlate provider-side vs infra issues. Chen: I'll add a small dashboard with correlation scatter and a lag plot; need a short-lived alert: when interruption rate > 4% AND provider_preempt_signal_rate > 2% for 10m. ops-bot: created incident RED-APNE1-2139876543 with severity:warning. Link: https://incidents.redwood/RED-APNE1-2139876543 Jules: Thanks — action items: (1) Chen add correlation dashboard, (2) Marco implement refractory alert rule and canary routing, (3) Priya define composite SLO, (4) Sofia update on-call runbook. We'll sync in 30m. :thumbsup:
